description_zh: 車輛頁依出廠母型整理變體；排行榜與 CR 則按車輛變體分開計算。
description_en: Vehicle pages organize variants under factory models, while leaderboards and CR badges are calculated per vehicle variant.
sidebar_zh: `vehicle_model_code` 用於車輛頁歸類；排行榜與 CR 使用 `vehicle_variant_code`。
同一母型下的 V2、Tuned、Attack 等變體各自保有 CR；若同時也是整條路線最快，則升級顯示為 TR。
熱門度先以有效紀錄數粗分，讓熱門車型優先顯示在前段。
sidebar_en: `vehicle_model_code` groups vehicle pages; leaderboards and CR use `vehicle_variant_code`.
V2, Tuned, Attack, and other variants under one model retain separate CRs; a route-best run upgrades to TR.
Popularity is currently bucketed by valid-run volume so heavily used cars surface first.
